operations.name: drive.delete
operations.description: Delete a saved document from My Documents by id.

operations.name: drive.list
operations.description: List saved documents in My Documents (the local drive), newest first. Cloud-synced docs carry a `cloud` link.

operations.name: drive.open
operations.description: Open a saved document by id (from drive.list) into a new tab.

operations.name: drive.pull
operations.description: Download a cloud drive document into the local drive and return its local metadata. Works read-only after a pass lapses.

operations.name: drive.save
operations.description: Save the current document to My Documents in the native format (overwrites the same entry on re-save; also refreshes the cloud copy for pass holders). Optional name defaults to the current document name.

name.description: Name to save as (default: current document name)

operations.name: drive.sync
operations.description: Push a local drive document to the cloud drive (requires an active pass; errors carry the gateway quota/entitlement detail).
